{"name":"lc-api-ratelimit","category":"API reference","toolId":"doc.api.reference","prompt":"What is the rate limit and the required auth header for the search endpoint?","rawOutput":"Search API Reference
Overview
The Search API lets you query the catalog. It is REST over HTTPS and returns JSON.
Endpoints
GET /v1/search — full text search across products
GET /v1/categories — list the category tree
GET /v1/suggest — typeahead suggestions
Authentication
All requests require the header Authorization: Bearer <token>.
Rate limits
The /v1/search endpoint is limited to 60 requests per minute per key.
Pagination
Use the "cursor" query parameter to page through results.
Errors
The API returns standard HTTP status codes and a JSON error body.
Support
